crossRefs.note: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
crossRefs.keyword: in thee, etc. or, thee do I wait for. do

crossRefs.note: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
crossRefs.keyword: in thee, etc. or, thee do I wait for. do

crossRefs.note: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

translations.web: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.
translations.bsb: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
translations.kjv: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
translations.asv: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.
